scope: synthetic declared case-graph quality only; not a real case constructor or model
designDisclosure: Known ALFRED availability-before-quote anomaly motivated v2; no claim of wholly data-naive design. v1 remains stopped.
inheritUnchanged: v1 chronological splits and minimum samples/classes
v1 publication prohibition and prospective review requirements

quality.globalStop: Unlocatable dates/identities, unknown schema, duplicate/conflicting slots or case identities, unresolved references, malformed graph. No repair.
quality.localQuarantine: Retain original slot for nonpositive/nonfinite numeric value, unknown/quarantined status, availability before quote. Never delete before selection.
quality.fixedGraph: All declared availability batches retained, with one candidate per batch and horizon. This superset is not verified v1 latest-quote-advancement issuance. Original feature/anchor/endpoint/path identities never change under quality overlays.
quality.selectionDependencies: Caller declares current/prior latest-state, feature-window selection and anchor selection support including excluded possible members; graph consistency is not completeness certification.
quality.intervalDependencies: Every original slot from anchor through endpoint, including null/unknown/quarantined; fixed declared h+1 quote path, never bridge a quarantine or replace an endpoint.
quality.closure: Feature closure must be known by issue; label closure and all interval availability+2 times define maturity and purge. Unknown closure is unavailable. Synthetic closure dates are not historical evidence.

evaluationPlan.pairing: Candidate and every baseline use exactly the same frozen qualified case identities; prediction failure cannot silently drop rows.
evaluationPlan.strongBaselineGateDraft: Extend paired Brier/logloss comparisons to uncalibrated full logistic, not merely report it; independent review required before freezing any gate.
evaluationPlan.coverage: Count original declared candidates, retained graph-quality cases, overlapping reasons by year, phase and horizon. Later report class balance only if real execution separately admitted. Selection is not random; results cannot generalize to excluded periods.
evaluationPlan.independentAuthenticityGate: Separate evidence review of original availability, version identity, calendar/dependency completeness, and source rights. Filtering never proves remaining timing correct.
